entities.name: Arimaya
entities.description: Leader of Clan Onyx of Storgard during the Ice Age, who stayed until the Fall of Storgard.

entities.name: Oriel Kjeldos
entities.description: Clan Emerald leader of Storgard who decided to leave the city.

entities.name: Bardo
entities.description: A northern paladin of Parma who served in Gull's wizard-hunting army and died rescuing Norreen.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Leader of a wizard-hunting army alongside Greensleeves.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A wizard who, with Gull, led the army that subdued Aerona's wizards using the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: A wizard who fought at White Ridge, gave copied Nova Pentacles to other wizards and lost his magic.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: A device used by Greensleeves to restrain and drain wizards.

entities.name: Dacian
entities.description: A short-tempered wizard from Aerona who founded a congress of wizards and was killed at the Battle of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Dwen
entities.description: An ocean-mage of Aerona who swore loyalty to Greensleeves after the Battle of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Eusomoné
entities.description: A Hurloon minotaur who carried Foecleaver and gave it to his son Jared Carthalion.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Son of Eusomoné who fought Ravidel and befriended Yorgo.

entities.name: Fabia
entities.description: A wizard of Aerona who led a cult and later swore loyalty to Greensleeves.

entities.name: Haakon
aliases: Haakon the First, King of the Badlands
entities.description: A brawny Aerona wizard who founded a wizard alliance with Dacian and was killed by Greensleeves at the Battle of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Helki
entities.description: A Windseeker centaur who became captain of the Rose Cavalry.

entities.name: Holleb
entities.description: Helki's husband, a Windseeker centaur tracker and captain of the Gold Cavalry.

entities.name: Hurn
entities.description: Leader of Clan Pearl of Storgard who became its military commander after Zilgeth's death.

entities.name: Mariska
entities.description: Hurn's wife who gave the Fyndhorn Bow and Shield of the Ages to Jason Carthalion.

entities.name: Immugio
entities.description: A half-ogre, half-giant wizard who commanded an army and swore to serve Liko.

entities.name: Jayne
entities.description: A scout who became leader of the Ravens in Gull's army.

entities.name: Kalenth Ush
entities.description: A Keldon werewolf who made werewolves of captured villagers and was killed by Kolli.

entities.name: Kolli
entities.description: A fourteen-year-old girl bitten by Kalenth Ush who became a werewolf and killed him.

entities.name: Kyree
entities.description: A young Haari tribe member who took an angel's feather during her Hunt.

entities.name: Adriel
entities.description: A Serra Angel who chased Kyree after she took the Ivory Cup.

entities.name: Leechnip
entities.description: A troll wizard of Aerona who summoned Ur-Drago and was killed at the Battle of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Liko
entities.description: A two-headed giant of Aerona who joined the wizard-hunting army.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A giant merfolk considered a sea god, who met Greensleeves at Lat-Nam in 4077 AR.

entities.name: Lorthun
entities.description: The dwarven leader of Clan Sapphire of Storgard who stayed until its fall.

entities.name: Ludoc
entities.description: A mountain mage of Aerona subjugated by the Stone Brain who later submitted to Greensleeves.

entities.name: Narok
entities.description: Ravidel's orc-like lieutenant who killed Nikko and was killed by Jared Carthalion at Castle Melmereth.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A battlemage with giant spiders and field lieutenant Narok.

entities.name: Stiggur
entities.description: A boy in Gull's army who piloted the clockwork beast Knothead.

entities.name: Knothead
entities.description: A thirty-foot clockwork beast piloted by Stiggur.

entities.name: Uxmal
entities.description: A dwarven sapper who led thirty dwarves into Gull's army.

entities.name: Yorgo
entities.description: The leader of Arathoxia's homeless youths, Jared Carthalion's former nemesis and ally, killed in the Planeswalker War.

entities.name: Zilgeth
entities.description: Mage leader of Clan Ruby and Storgard's military commander who sacrificed himself against a Johtull Wurm.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Became leader of Clan Ruby after Zilgeth's death.

entities.name: Rikala
entities.description: The king of the homarids on Dominaria.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: A city of clans during the Ice Age, which fell.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The battle in which Greensleeves's forces defeated the congress of wizards.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: A place destroyed in 4073 AR in a fight involving Towser and Dacian.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where these minor characters live.

events.summary: Bardo is killed by Benalish wyvern-mounted lancers while rescuing Norreen from torture in Benalia City.
events.quote: He was killed by Benalish wyvern -mounted lancers while rescuing Norreen from torture in Benalia City .

events.summary: Dacian fights Towser in the destruction of White Ridge, then is pursued and subdued by the Stone Brain.
events.quote: After fleeing White Ridge , she was pursued by Gull and Greensleeves and was subdued by the Stone Brain .

events.summary: Dacian is killed by a D'Avenant archer during the Battle of Lat-Nam.
events.quote: She was killed by a D'Avenant archer during the Battle of Lat-Nam .

events.summary: Greensleeves breaks Dwen's wrists and drains her mana at Lat-Nam; Dwen swears loyalty to her.
events.quote: Her wrists were broken and her mana drained by Greensleeves during the Battle of Lat-Nam .

events.summary: Eusomoné is summoned by his son Jared to fight Ravidel's giant spiders and gives him Foecleaver.
After the deaths of Dacian, Leechnip and Haakon, Fabia flees but Greensleeves drains her mana and youth, forcing her to swear loyalty.
events.quote: Greensleeves used a Force of Nature to drain her of her mana and youth

events.summary: Haakon is captured and placed in the Stone Brain, conjures gremlins to steal it and loses an eye.
events.quote: He conjured Phyrexian gremlins to steal the brain, but lost an eye in the process.

events.summary: Haakon is killed by a Lightning Bolt cast by Greensleeves at the Battle of Lat-Nam.
events.quote: He was killed by a Lightning Bolt cast by Greensleeves during the Battle of Lat-Nam .

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves stop Immugio's siege of Myrion in 4077 AR.
events.quote: he laid siege to the city of Myrion in 4077 AR , but was stopped by Gull and Greensleeves

events.summary: Immugio peels the face from his dying giant father to make a death mask.
events.quote: he ambushed his father, peeled his face from his skull as he died

events.summary: Kalenth Ush bites Kolli; she becomes a werewolf, escapes and kills him with a sword.
events.quote: managed to kill him with a sword

events.summary: Kyree takes the Ivory Cup from Indorin's Tomb, awakening the Serra Angel Adriel, and escapes holding one of her feathers.
events.quote: she had lost the Ivory Cup but was instead clutching one of the angel's golden feathers

events.summary: Leechnip summons Ur-Drago, which kills three of Greensleeves's Guardians, and is later killed at Lat-Nam.
events.quote: he summoned Ur-Drago , which killed three of Greensleeves ' Guardians

events.summary: Ludoc abandons Towser, is drained by Greensleeves and swears loyalty to her.
events.quote: He submitted to Greensleeves and swore loyalty and allegiance to save his magic from being drained completely.

events.summary: Mariska gives the Fyndhorn Bow and Shield of the Ages to Jason Carthalion, and she and Hurn leave Storgard before its fall.
events.quote: Mariska and her husband left the city with Kjeldos before the Fall of Storgard

events.summary: Narok kills Nikko and is killed by Jared Carthalion at Castle Melmereth.
events.quote: was in turn killed by one of Jared Carthalion 's spells during the battle at Castle Melmereth

events.summary: Zilgeth sacrifices himself with an Incinerate spell to fend off a Johtull Wurm attacking Storgard.
events.quote: Zilgeth sacrificed himself to fend off the creature with an Incinerate spell

events.summary: After Zilgeth's death Freyalise becomes leader of Clan Ruby.
events.quote: Freyalise became the new leader of Clan Ruby
